name: shoot.invite
description: Sends the Lark invite to the crew not invited yet: someone added after the first invite gets one, and nobody gets a second. An effect: it sends only what a person approved. Lark must be linked first.
payload: select jsonb_build_object('shoot', s.id, 'title', s.title, 'day', s.day, 'start', s.start, 'end', s."end", 'place', s.place, 'people', jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', c.id, 'name', c.name, 'role', c.role) order by c.position)) as result from brandbase.shoots s join brandbase.crew c on c.shoot_id = s.id where s.id = :id and s.brand_id = :brand and c.invited_at is null group by s.id
sql:
with invited as (
  update brandbase.crew c set invited_at = :now::timestamptz
  where c.shoot_id = :id and c.invited_at is null
    and c.id in (select p ->> 'id' from jsonb_array_elements(:payload::jsonb -> 'people') p)
  returning c.*
)
select brandbase.shoot_json(to_jsonb(s), coalesce((select jsonb_agg(z.c) from (
  select to_jsonb(c) as c from brandbase.crew c where c.shoot_id = s.id and c.id not in (select id from invited)
  union all select to_jsonb(i) from invited i) z), '[]'))
  || jsonb_build_object('invited', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(p ->> 'name'), '[]') from jsonb_array_elements(:payload::jsonb -> 'people') p)) as result
from brandbase.shoots s where s.id = :id and s.brand_id = :brand
